discovery_note: sources/lisbon.json records only that an /rss-feed link was observed on the culture page. That page is itself a directory of several distinct named feeds (RSS de Notícias at /pages/321.rss, RSS de Eventos at /pages/322.rss) — ingestion/odivelas/discovery.mjs finds the one labelled RSS de Eventos rather than hardcoding its path.

requests_made.purpose: discover the RSS de Eventos feed URL

findings.pubdate_is_event_time: This feed exposes no separate event-start field distinct from pubDate; cross-checking retained live items (an evening theatre item with pubDate reading 21:00 local-equivalent) shows pubDate is reused to carry the actual event date/time, not a distinct publish timestamp — see ingestion/odivelas/observation-adapter.mjs.
findings.venue_field: No structured venue field exists. Item description HTML commonly (not always) contains a Contacto: {name} line naming a department or venue — extracted verbatim into location_text, never split or asserted as a canonical venue name.
